verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch operations are a fair axis for a generation API, but the evidence shows no documented way to act on many items at once, such as a batch endpoint, multi-item jobs or bulk management. The closest items are adjacent: dedicated throughput capacity for scale, campaign adaptation marketing copy, and reusable Skills workflows. None of these is a bulk operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
